name: week-capsules
title: Week Capsules
description: A week of minutes: capsules fill in turn, glowing at the goal, and today's breathes inside a ring.

perf.budget: Capsules use short UI-thread springs on arrival. Today's ring breathes as one view, so it animates at rest.

a11y.reducedMotion: Capsules appear filled, the ring holds still and the number does not count.

meta.guide:
## Usage

```tsx
import { WeekCapsules } from '@/components/kinetik/week-capsules';

<WeekCapsules
  days={[
    { label: 'F', minutes: 22 },
    { label: 'S', minutes: 34 },
    { label: 'S', minutes: 18 },
    { label: 'M', minutes: 41 },
    { label: 'T', minutes: 38 },
    { label: 'W', minutes: 45 },
    { label: 'T', minutes: 19 },
  ]}
  goal={30}
/>;
```

## When to use

- A daily habit with a goal: exercise, reading, meditation.
- A small widget beside other health or focus stats.

## When not to use

- More than a week or so. Use Heat Grid.
- Values with no goal: nothing marks a good day.

## Notes

- The last day is today.
- A capsule glows once its day reaches `goal`.

docs: Prefer `npx kinetik-ui add week-capsules`: it installs dependencies with expo install, so versions match your Expo SDK.
